profiles.scope: PNG rendering of a page-view rectangle; not content-stream clipping.

read.scope: This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion.

create.scope: This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion.

edit_authored.scope: This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion.

edit_imported.scope: This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion.

preserve.scope: This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion.

render.scope: Display-space rectangles honor CropBox, rotations and UserUnit; finite/positive/intersection/resource checks. Tested tolerances are fixture-specific, not universal pixel identity.

export.scope: This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion.

profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic small PDFs built in test_render_clipping.py with native authoring; explicit CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit dictionaries in the test exercise geometry. PNG samples are decoded by the local test helper, with narrow fixture-specific rounding tolerances. No third-party PDF corpus is implied.

profiles.scope: Strict scalar custom properties, separate from core/extended metadata.

read.scope: lpwstr, bool, i8 and finite r8 only; 1024 entries / 64 KiB value / 256 KiB raw aggregate. ASCII-ambiguous names all omitted. Native malformed-part drops and source caps prevent a complete source inventory.

create.scope: Four supported Python scalar types round-trip through native DOCX serialization.

edit_authored.scope: Owned metadata batches support update/clear and atomic rejection; this does not preserve arbitrary unsupported source variants.

edit_imported.scope: Imported DOCX editing is not exposed by the current conservative edit profile.

preserve.scope: Arbitrary source custom-property parts, unsupported variants and raw package identity are not covered by authored round-trip tests.

export.scope: This row does not promise a PDF mapping for DOCX custom properties.

profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic DOCX built by the public authoring API; test_imported_properties.py replaces the custom property ZIP part with explicit scalar, malformed, duplicate and oversized XML fixtures. Source patches are test-only, not a runtime parser/writer.

profiles.scope: Native table caption/description projected as metadata; absent differs from empty.

read.scope: Retained native title/description is exposed at each table depth without adding visible text. Native reader caps each alternative text at 10000 characters.

create.scope: Authored title/description serialize and read back for the tested bounded profile.

edit_authored.scope: Existing table.format sets title and description; no additional metadata manager.

edit_imported.scope: Imported DOCX edit profile remains unavailable.

preserve.scope: Absent/empty and retained authored values survive serialization. Source values beyond the native cap are not preserved.

export.scope: No evidence here establishes PDF accessibility tags or an alternate-text conversion mapping.

profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic authored outer/nested tables plus the local test_docx_stories.py story fixture; the native cap regression patches an authored tblCaption to 10001 Omega characters. Empty and absent values are asserted separately.

profiles.scope: Page insertion/selection and optional outline-preserving imports within the conservative editable source profile.

read.scope: Resulting page order, selected text and supported links/outlines reopen as expected.

create.scope: Assemble selected source pages and serialize a new PDF.

edit_authored.scope: Reorder/delete selected pages using native operations; outline and link assertions cover tested targets.

edit_imported.scope: Conservative readable source profile only; encrypted/imported AcroForm sources and incomplete outline inventories are explicitly rejected.

preserve.scope: Tested page content, links and selected outline destinations survive. Optional outline import can omit destinations outside the selection; document-wide tags/metadata are not implied.

render.scope: Tested imported/reordered page content renders after serialization.

export.scope: Native PDF serialization is part of create/edit; this profile makes no PDF-to-DOCX conversion claim.

profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic PDFs authored within test_pdf_outline_import.py with numbered text, nested bookmarks, internal and URI links; no external source assets. Tests explicitly select duplicate/out-of-order pages and reopen the serialized result.

profiles.scope: Owned single-widget text/checkbox/choice fields with fixed appearances; no radio/script/multiline profile.

read.scope: Owned field handles expose bounded values/options and current-view geometry. This is not imported AcroForm extraction.

create.scope: Create the supported text/checkbox/choice kinds with validated options and fixed-size appearance fit. The adapter separately caps the owned model at 1000 fields; these fixtures do not exhaust that limit.

edit_authored.scope: Fill, resize/move, delete and flatten the supported owned profile atomically; preserve widget orientation when pages rotate.

edit_imported.scope: Current adapter rejects imported AcroForms. U10 documents the bounded-inventory constraint; complete enumeration call-path evidence is still required before migrating this to a blocked_upstream cell.

preserve.scope: Owned copies/page organization retain tested values/widgets. This does not establish arbitrary field-dictionary or imported form preservation.

render.scope: Visible text/checkbox/choice appearances and tested flattening render as expected, including rotated/cropped/UserUnit geometry.

export.scope: PDF-to-DOCX conversion rejects active forms; native PDF save and flatten are different operations.

profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic PDFs authored in test_pdf_fields.py and test_field_geometry.py; the latter uses local PDF geometry fixtures with rotation/CropBox/UserUnit. Assertions inspect actual PNG pixels, metadata, owned copy independence and flattening results.

profiles.scope: Authored blank/title/title_and_content/two_content layouts and inherited placeholders.

read.scope: Extract rendered slide content and inspect roles on authored shape handles; no imported editable layout inventory.

create.scope: Four verified native default layouts allocate fresh identities and serialize.

edit_authored.scope: Placeholder text/box/rotation changes are supported; layout reassignment and arbitrary theme/master editing are not claimed.

edit_imported.scope: Imported PPTX editing is outside the current editable profile.

preserve.scope: Untouched authored placeholder transforms/master references remain inherited during tested neighboring edits. General source theme/package preservation is unassessed.

render.scope: Actual placeholder content renders for all four tested layouts.

export.scope: PPTX-to-PDF fixture content reopens and renders; no pixel-perfect Office equivalence is claimed.

profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic DeckCraft default layouts reached through public Python authoring; tests fill every placeholder and inspect the authored PPTX ZIP parts. They reopen PPTX and exported PDF and inspect actual label text/PNG pixels; this is not independent PowerPoint validation.

profiles.scope: Secure removal of vertical-writing text beneath a redaction mark; no public package redaction API currently.

read.scope: This profile concerns removal, not extraction of vertical text.

create.scope: No current public redaction creation API.

edit_authored.scope: Native application explicitly fails closed for vertical-writing text; implementing the general removal guarantee requires upstream geometry work.

edit_imported.scope: Same vertical-writing removal limitation; presence of the native redaction crate does not establish this operation.

preserve.scope: No package redaction operation or preservation corpus exists for this profile.

render.scope: An opaque overlay is not evidence that underlying content was removed.

export.scope: A format conversion is not a secure-redaction guarantee.

profiles.fixture_provenance: No local package fixture because the operation is absent. Native source fixture crates/redact/src/tests.rs::vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed constructs the failure case; inspected at the pinned revision, not rerun by this ledger validation.
